gpuBlackMarket.note: NEW (checked 2026-09-20): HUAWEI SETS THE DOMESTIC PRICE AGENDA; GREY-MARKET PREMIUMS UNCHANGED. At its Shanghai summit (Sep 17) Huawei RAISED the price of its Ascend 950DT chip by 60%, citing tight component supply; rotating chairman Eric Xu said Huawei cannot produce enough AI computing equipment to meet Chinese demand and is limiting overseas sales, and that 'Ascend market share should be bigger than Nvidia's' in China. The Ascend 960DT is pulled forward to Q1 2027 (three quarters early) and the 960PR to Q3 2027 (one quarter early), with 970/980 in 2028/29 and a new generation every year; a new 'Peerium' architecture is designed to eventually link up to 1 million processors, and the Ascend 960 supernode will connect up to 4,096 processors (>1,000 systems on Ascend 910C already deployed, Ascend 950 in commercial use). DeepSeek plans to deploy at least 160,000 Ascend 950DT chips at its Inner Mongolia data centre. Bernstein still estimates the Ascend 950 offers only ~6% of Nvidia's next-gen VR200 performance. No fresh grey-market print broke this week — the ~2x-of-list band for restricted Nvidia kit stands (DGX B300 >¥8M, B200 racks ¥3-3.5M). PRIOR (Sep 13 check): no fresh pricing print that week; 3-10x band confirmed. Corroborating datapoints now in the record: China grey-market prices run ~2x list for banned Nvidia kit — a restricted DGX B300 server sells for more than ¥8M (~$1.1M), over double its price six months earlier; B200 racks fetch ¥3-3.5M (~$489K), a ~50% premium over equivalent US pricing, traded through distributor/middleman networks concentrated in Guangdong and Zhejiang (FT, via Crypto Briefing/StartupXO). Epoch AI estimates 290,000-1.6M H100-equivalent GPUs were smuggled into China through end-2025. Rental economics: Chinese H100 rental prices rose ~20-30% from Oct 2025, with one-year leases up close to 40%, driven by cost inflation across memory/GPU/optical modules and by demand — China's National Data Administration put daily token calls above 140 TRILLION by March 2026, up from 100bn in early 2024 (>1,000x in two years) — even as global H100 rental rates cratered 64-75% from their 2023 peak. Enforcement: DOJ indicted three Super Micro figures over an alleged ~$2.5bn scheme shipping H100/H200/B200 servers to Chinese buyers through Southeast Asian front companies; Sharetronic filings showed $92M of banned-server inventory. PRIOR CONTEXT: Blackwell 8-GPU server >$600K (~2x official); 8-GPU H200 server ~$250K, a modest premium; RTX 6000 Pro workstation chip surged ~50,000→130,000 yuan YTD; US export licences (Jan 2026 reversal, 25% levy) approved for 10 Chinese firms but most licensed China-bound volume still NOT shipping — supply landing with US/EU/Gulf buyers; CFO Kress (Aug 26): no revenue recognised from approved H200 shipments because China has not allowed imports. Market structure: Bernstein projects Nvidia's China share falling to ~8% in 2026 while Huawei's Ascend climbs toward 50%; Huawei projected to take ~60% of China's AI chip market by end-2026 (>$12B revenue); DeepSeek self-developed chip in progress; China's $295B AI grid plan locks Nvidia out. Legal channel unproven → grey premium structurally supported. Updated 2026-09-20
gpuBlackMarket.note_zh: 新（核查于2026-09-20）：华为主导国内定价；灰市溢价未变。在9月17日上海峰会上，华为主力产品昇腾950DT提价60%，理由是元件供应紧张；轮值董事长徐直军称华为AI算力设备产能无法满足中国需求、正限制海外销售，并表示在华'昇腾份额应大于英伟达'。昇腾960DT提前至2027年Q1（提早三个季度）、960PR提前至2027年Q3（提早一个季度），2028/29年推出970/980，此后每年一代；新'Peerium'架构目标最终连接多达100万颗处理器，昇腾960超节点最多连接4,096颗处理器（昇腾910C系统已部署逾1,000套、昇腾950已商用）。DeepSeek计划在其内蒙古数据中心部署至少16万颗昇腾950DT。Bernstein仍估计昇腾950性能仅为英伟达下一代VR200的约6%。本周无新灰市报价——受限英伟达产品的约官方价2倍区间维持（DGX B300>¥800万、B200整机架¥300-350万）。前情（9月13日核查）：当周无新报价；3-10倍区间确认。现有佐证数据点：中国灰市被禁英伟达产品价格约为官方价2倍——受限制的DGX B300服务器售价逾¥800万（约$110万），为半年前价格的两倍以上；B200整机架¥300-350万（约$48.9万），较美国同类价溢价约50%，交易通过集中于广东和浙江的分销商/中间人网络完成（FT，经Crypto Briefing/StartupXO）。Epoch AI估计至2025年底有29万-160万块H100等效GPU被走私入华。租赁经济：中国H100租金自2025年10月起上涨约20-30%，一年期合约涨幅接近40%，受内存/GPU/光模块成本上涨与需求驱动——中国国家数据局称截至2026年3月日均Token调用超140万亿次，2024年初为1000亿（两年增长超1000倍）——而全球H100租金较2023年峰值下跌64-75%。执法：美司法部起诉三名美超微相关人员，指其通过东南亚空壳公司向中国买家发运H100/H200/B200服务器，涉案约$25亿；Sharetronic申报文件显示$9200万被禁服务器库存。前情：Blackwell 8卡服务器>$60万（约官方价2倍）；8卡H200服务器约$25万、溢价温和；RTX 6000 Pro工作站芯片年内从约5万元涨至13万元；美出口许可（2026年1月政策反转，25%抽成）已批给10家中国企业，但大多数获批对华配额实际尚未出货——供应流向美国/欧盟/海湾买家；CFO柯蕾丝（8月26日）：获批H200出货尚未确认收入，因中国未允许进口。市场结构：Bernstein预计2026年英伟达中国份额降至约8%，华为昇腾升至约50%；华为据预测2026年底占据中国AI芯片市场约60%（收入超$120亿）；DeepSeek自研芯片推进中；中国$2950亿AI算力网排挤英伟达。合法渠道未证实→灰市溢价结构性支撑。更新于 2026-09-20

chinaAiAdoption.note: NEW (checked 2026-09-20): DEEPSEEK LOCKS IN DOMESTIC SILICON. Bloomberg/Reuters (Sep 17): DeepSeek plans to deploy at least 160,000 Huawei Ascend 950DT chips at the Inner Mongolia data centre it is building — the clearest sign yet that China's frontier-model inference is moving onto domestic accelerators as Huawei says it cannot meet demand and is limiting overseas sales. Huawei supervisory-board chairman Guo Ping said the company views AI as its 'biggest opportunity' and wants computing/connectivity infrastructure to play a role comparable to Nvidia's, aiming for Ascend chips to run every major AI model in China and beyond. Diplomatic backdrop: Xi Jinping and Donald Trump are due to meet in Washington on Sep 24, 2026. No new model releases or MAU figures broke this week. PRIOR (checked 2026-09-13): DEEPSEEK SHIPPED V4.1-FLASH ON SEP 10 — third release in four weeks. DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash reached the API on Sep 10 at $1.20 per million output tokens during peak hours and is framed as making large-scale AI inference cheaper (Analytics India Mag); DeepSeek says the new Flash model beats Kimi K3 on cyber and coding benchmarks (SCMP, Sep 10); weights on Hugging Face (deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash). Moonshot AI's Kimi K3 — described as the world's largest open-weight model — is the new competitive reference point. Scale: DeepSeek had 129M monthly app users in China in June 2026, third behind Doubao and Qwen; deepseek.com drew 353.8M visits in August (~6% of chatgpt.com's traffic); 371M model downloads on Hugging Face. PRIOR CONTEXT: V4-Pro GA Aug 13 and V4-Flash-Vision-Exp Aug 21 (beats Claude Opus 4.8 on 3/11 agent benchmarks); Qwen3.8-Max GA Aug 3 (Alibaba's largest model); QuestMobile: China's AI-native apps reached 499M MAU (+85.4% YoY) — Doubao 382M, Qwen 167M, DeepSeek 129M; pricing reset live since Aug 16 (peak output $3.96/M = 4.5x prior; off-peak $1.98/M; cache-hit input off-peak $0.022/M); V4-Pro concurrency cap 500 vs Flash 2,500; legacy deepseek-chat/deepseek-reasoner endpoints deprecated with migration deadline Oct 24, 2026. DeepSeek is building a massive AI data centre in Inner Mongolia (Ulanqab, ~1 GW); Apple trained its own China LLM with Alibaba after Beijing clearance. Updated 2026-09-20
chinaAiAdoption.note_zh: 新（核查于2026-09-20）：DeepSeek 锁定国产算力。彭博/路透（9月17日）：DeepSeek计划在其正在建设的内蒙古数据中心部署至少16万颗华为昇腾950DT芯片——这是中国前沿模型推理转向国产加速器的最明确信号，而华为此前称产能无法满足需求并限制海外销售。华为监事会主席郭平称公司视AI为'最大机遇'，希望其计算与连接基础设施发挥与英伟达相当的作用，目标是让昇腾芯片能运行中国乃至全球的每一个主流AI模型。外交背景：习近平与特朗普将于2026年9月24日在华盛顿会晤。本周无新模型发布或月活数据。前情（核查于2026-09-13）：DeepSeek于9月10日发布V4.1-Flash——四周内第三次发布。DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash于9月10日上线API，高峰时段输出$1.20/百万tokens，定位为降低大规模AI推理成本（Analytics India Mag）；DeepSeek称新Flash模型在网络和编程基准上超过Kimi K3（南华早报，9月10日）；权重已在Hugging Face（deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash）。月之暗面的Kimi K3——被称为全球最大开放权重模型——成为新的竞争参照。规模：DeepSeek 2026年6月在中国月活应用用户1.29亿，居豆包、Qwen之后第三；deepseek.com 8月访问3.538亿次（约为chatgpt.com流量的6%）；Hugging Face模型下载3.71亿次。前情：V4-Pro 8月13日GA、V4-Flash-Vision-Exp 8月21日（11项agent基准中3项超过Claude Opus 4.8）；Qwen3.8-Max 8月3日GA（阿里迄今最大模型）；QuestMobile：中国AI原生应用月活达4.99亿（同比+85.4%）——豆包3.82亿、Qwen 1.67亿、DeepSeek 1.29亿；8月16日起新定价生效（高峰输出$3.96/百万=此前4.5倍；谷时$1.98；缓存命中输入谷时$0.022/M）；V4-Pro并发上限500 vs Flash 2,500；旧版deepseek-chat/deepseek-reasoner端点弃用，迁移截止2026年10月24日。DeepSeek正在内蒙古乌兰察布建设大型AI数据中心（约1GW）；苹果获北京批准后与阿里合作训练中国本土LLM。更新于 2026-09-20

aiMilitaryDeployment.note: NEW (checked 2026-09-20): DOCTRINE-LEVEL ARTICULATION OF AI WARFARE. A PLA internal report on the future of air warfare, published in September in Liberation Army News (the PLA's official paper) and translated by the USAF's China Aerospace Studies Institute, describes a doctrine built around autonomous drone swarms under AI decision-making, crewed aircraft directing drone formations, hypersonic weapons, and deliberate cognitive attacks on enemy command systems. CASI judges the piece carries 'the imprimatur of orthodoxy' — official thinking, not speculation. Central claim: 'The future form of air warfare is ultimately and inevitably intelligentized aerial combat'; the architecture is 'system-of-systems operations' — self-adaptive, self-coordinating platforms networked under a central AI layer. The most operationally significant section is cognitive warfare: 'hard kills' paired with information operations designed to collapse enemy decision-making, with 'decision-centric', mosaic and algorithmic warfare all named as capabilities that could appear on the battlefield 'in the not-too-distant future'. Ground/robotics: Reuters (Sep 7) — records show the National University of Defense Technology modelling six-robot assault teams (humanoids + quadruped dogs + UGVs) clearing a building floor by floor alongside troops; PLA Daily called for accelerating lab-to-training-ground transfer of robotic 'combatants' two days after the World Humanoid Robot Games; Chinese manufacturers made ~95% of global humanoid shipments in 2025 (BofA Global Research); Reuters found no evidence of an armed humanoid deployed with an operational PLA unit; the research projects availability within 5-10 years. Mobilisation: the NPC passed a revised National Defense Mobilization Law on Aug 28, effective Oct 1 — it allows the government to 'expropriate' private property rather than merely 'requisition' it and may be invocable below the threshold of war, materially improving the PLA's ability to conscript civilian AI and drone capacity and sealift (AEI/ISW, Sep 4). Reuters: unnamed US officials allege COSCO vessels carry hidden SIGINT equipment collecting data on military communications and encryption. COUNTERVAILING: earlier research (Defense Post, Sep 4) found China's AI-enabled 'attack chain' still trails foreign models on battlefield-AI benchmarks. Live testbed: Iran-UAV attacks on Gulf shipping, Houthi missile/drone strikes, US 'tanker-for-tanker' strikes and counter-drone ops continue. Updated 2026-09-20
aiMilitaryDeployment.note_zh: 新（核查于2026-09-13）：AI战争在教范层面被明确化。解放军一份关于未来空战的内部报告9月发表于《解放军报》（军方官方报纸），由美空军中国航空航天研究院（CASI）翻译，描述以AI决策下的自主无人机蜂群、有人机指挥无人机编队、高超音速武器、以及对敌方指挥系统的蓄意认知攻击为核心的作战理念。CASI判断此文具有'正统的印记'——属官方思想而非理论臆测。核心论断：'未来空战形态终将且必然走向智能化作战'；其架构是'体系作战'——在中央AI管理层之下联网的自主适应、自主协同平台。最具作战意义的不是硬件部分，而是认知战：将'硬杀伤'与旨在瓦解敌方决策的信息行动结合，并点明以决策为中心、马赛克战、算法战等能力'可能在不久的将来出现在战场上'。地面/机器人：路透（9月7日）——记录显示国防科技大学正在模拟6机器人突击队（人形+四足机器狗+无人地面车辆）与地面部队协同逐层清楼；《解放军报》在世界人形机器人运动会结束两天后呼吁加快尖端技术从实验室向军事训练场转移，打造机器人'战斗员'；2025年中国厂商占全球人形机器人出货约95%（美银全球研究）；路透未发现中国已在作战部队部署武装人形机器人；该研究预计5-10年内可用。动员：全国人大8月28日通过修订版《国防动员法》，10月1日生效——允许政府'征用'（而非仅'征调'）私有财产，且可能可在低于战争门槛时援引，实质提升解放军征调民用AI与无人机产能及海运能力（AEI/ISW，9月4日）。路透：不具名美方官员称中远海运船只携带隐蔽信号情报设备，收集军事通信与加密信息。反证：此前研究（Defense Post，9月4日）发现中国AI'杀伤链'在战场AI基准上仍落后外国模型。实战试验场：伊朗无人机袭击海湾航运、胡塞导弹/无人机袭击、美军'以船换船'打击与反无人机行动持续。更新于 2026-09-20

aiComputePower.note: NEW (checked 2026-09-20): FORWARD CAPACITY FORECAST RAISED. Wood Mackenzie (Aug 25): China's data centres will QUADRUPLE electricity consumption to 774 TWh by 2030 as AI workloads drive a structural rise in computing power demand — data centres going from ~1.5% to 6% of total national electricity consumption by 2030 and 17% by 2060; eight national hubs will hold >70% of capacity; a 'compute follows power' model is emerging (power-intensive training/batch/storage to renewable-rich western China, latency-sensitive inference staying east); carbon emissions from data centres peak around 2035. Gartner (Jun 10): GLOBAL data centre electricity consumption 565 TWh in 2026 (+26% YoY from 447 TWh) and global DC power demand 132 GW (+27% from 104 GW), heading to ~290 GW by 2030 — AI-optimised servers 31% of DC power in 2026 and surpassing conventional servers in 2027. Peer-reviewed modelling (Frontiers in Energy Research, Apr 2026) puts China's DC electricity at 277-500 TWh by 2030 across scenarios (base 500 TWh ≈ 3.85% of national consumption). China DC capacity figure itself unchanged at ~85 GW this cycle. Company-level: DeepSeek adding ~1 GW compute at Ulanqab, Inner Mongolia (Bloomberg/Japan Times, Aug 1) — domestic expansion continues despite export controls; China's $295B AI grid plan. Bond-market anxiety over AI capex persists; Nvidia's $500B+ third-party compute-financing platform (Apollo/BlackRock/Blackstone/Brookfield/Goldman/KKR, Aug 26) is the latest answer to capex-funding questions. Updated 2026-09-20
aiComputePower.note_zh: 新（核查于2026-09-13）：前瞻产能预测上调。伍德麦肯兹（8月25日）：中国数据中心用电到2030年将增至四倍达774TWh，AI工作负载推动算力需求结构性上升——数据中心占全国用电比重从约1.5%升至2030年6%、2060年17%；八个国家枢纽将承载70%以上容量；'算力跟着电力走'模式正在形成（高耗能训练/批处理/存储西迁至可再生能源富集区，时延敏感的推理留在东部）；数据中心碳排放约2035年见顶。Gartner（6月10日）：2026年全球数据中心用电565TWh（同比+26%，2025年为447TWh），全球DC电力需求132GW（同比+27%，2025年104GW），至2030年约290GW——AI优化服务器占DC用电31%，2027年将超过传统服务器。经同行评审建模（Frontiers in Energy Research，2026年4月）给出中国DC用电2030年277-500TWh的区间（基准500TWh≈全国用电3.85%）。中国数据中心容量本周期不变，约85GW。企业层面：DeepSeek在内蒙古乌兰察布新增约1GW算力（彭博/日本时报，8月1日）——出口管制下国产扩张继续；中国$2950亿AI算力网计划。债券市场对AI资本开支担忧持续；英伟达$5000亿+第三方算力融资平台（Apollo/BlackRock/Blackstone/Brookfield/Goldman/KKR，8月26日）是对资本开支融资问题的最新回应。更新于 2026-09-20

aiSpaceCapability.note: NEW (checked 2026-09-20): 666TH LONG MARCH FLIGHT. Sep 10, 17:00 Beijing time: a Long March 4B launched the Yaogan-53 (01-03) and Yaogan-56 (01-03) remote-sensing satellite groups from Jiuquan — a 'one rocket, six satellites' mission, all entered planned orbits (Xinhua/CGTN/Starpath). The mission marked the 666th flight of the Long March family, 56 years after a Long March 1 launched Dongfanghong-1 on Apr 24, 1970. Satellites are for scientific experiments, land and resource surveys, crop-yield estimation and disaster prevention/reduction. Cadence: Space Stats lists 60 Chinese orbital launches in 2026; Wikipedia's 2026 in spaceflight page shows 212 orbital launches globally (205 successes, 7 failures); Jiuquan 21 (19 OK), Wenchang 17 (16 OK), Taiyuan 11 (11 OK), Yellow Sea 4 (4 OK). China remains on course to exceed 100 launches in a calendar year for the first time (2026 target ~140 vs 93 in 2025). Setbacks unchanged: Chang'e 7 remains delayed to 2027 after the Aug 23 LM-5 Y14 scrub, following the Aug 10 LM-7A failure (4th of 2026, YF-100 family); Chang'e 8 planned for 2028-29. Milestone still standing: Zhuque-3's first private orbital booster recovery (Aug 18). Lunar/deep-space and 10,000-satellite constellation thresholds not yet met. Updated 2026-09-20
aiSpaceCapability.note_zh: 新（核查于2026-09-13）：长征第666次飞行。9月10日北京时间17:00：一枚长征四号乙在酒泉发射遥感53组（01-03）与遥感56组（01-03），为'一箭六星'任务，全部入轨（新华社/CGTN/Starpath）。该任务为长征系列第666次飞行，距1970年4月24日长征一号发射东方红一号已56年。卫星主要用于科学试验、国土资源普查、农作物估产和防灾减灾。发射节奏：Space Stats列出2026年中国60次入轨发射；维基百科《2026年航天》页显示全球入轨发射212次（205成功、7失败）；酒泉21次（19成功）、文昌17次（16成功）、太原11次（11成功）、黄海4次（4成功）。中国仍有望首次在单个自然年发射超100次（2026年目标约140次 vs 2025年93次）。挫折未变：嫦娥七号在8月23日长征五号Y14取消后仍延至2027年，此前8月10日长征七号甲故障（2026年第4次失败，YF-100发动机家族）；嫦娥八号计划2028-29年。里程碑仍有效：朱雀三号首次民营轨道级助推器回收（8月18日）。月球/深空与万颗卫星星座阈值尚未达到。更新于 2026-09-20

nvdaAsiaRevenue.note: No new earnings at the Sep 13 check (Q2 FY27 reported Aug 26; next print ~mid-Nov). Q2 FY27 BEAT: revenue $96.2B (+106% YoY, +18% QoQ) vs $91B guide and ~$92.07B consensus; Data Center $89.0B (+117%, >91% of total sales); non-GAAP EPS $2.22; GM 75.0%; $26.0B returned to shareholders in the quarter; next quarterly dividend $0.25 payable Oct 1. Q3 FY27 guide $108B ±2% — STILL assumes ZERO Data Center compute revenue from China; CFO Kress: 'given ongoing geopolitical uncertainty, there is no China data center compute revenue in our forward outlook.' NEW detail: Hopper-architecture products shipped to China accounted for LESS THAN 1% of data centre revenue in the quarter, and those shipments were dilutive to gross margin — the China line has become immaterial either way. H200 export licences obtained but NO revenue recognised from approved shipments (China has not allowed imports); H200 availability outside China stays comfortable as licensed China-bound volume largely is not shipping. Structural note: ~one-fifth of Nvidia's FY2026 revenue came from Singapore — its second-largest market after the US — reflecting Chinese firms training abroad to access export-controlled silicon (Asia Times). Wall Street models ~44% revenue growth for FY2028; Nvidia's own 70% forecast rate would imply ~$675B vs the ~$574B consensus. Vera Rubin in full production; $500B+ third-party compute financing (Apollo/BlackRock/Blackstone/Brookfield/Goldman/KKR); stock rose post-print. AI capex cycle intact per this print. Watch 'China'/'Singapore' revenue lines next quarter. Updated 2026-09-20
nvdaAsiaRevenue.note_zh: 9月13日核查无新财报（FY27 Q2于8月26日发布；下次约11月中）。FY27 Q2超预期：营收$962亿（同比+106%，环比+18%）vs $910亿指引和约$920.7亿共识；数据中心$890亿（+117%，占总销售>91%）；非GAAP EPS $2.22；毛利率75.0%；本季向股东返还$260亿；下次季度股息$0.25于10月1日支付。FY27 Q3指引$1080亿±2%——仍假设中国数据中心计算收入为零；CFO柯蕾丝：'鉴于持续的地缘政治不确定性，我们的前瞻展望中没有中国数据中心计算收入。'新细节：本季发往中国的Hopper架构产品占数据中心收入不足1%，且这些出货对毛利率有摊薄作用——无论如何中国业务已变得无关紧要。H200出口许可证已获得，但获批出货尚未确认任何收入（中国尚未允许进口）；因获批对华配额基本未出货，H200在美国以外供应充裕。结构性提示：英伟达FY2026约五分之一收入来自新加坡——为美国之后第二大市场——反映中国企业赴海外训练以获取受出口管制的芯片（亚洲时报）。华尔街为FY2028建模约44%营收增长；英伟达自身70%的预测增速意味着约$6750亿 vs 约$5740亿共识。Vera Rubin全面投产；$5000亿+第三方算力融资（Apollo/BlackRock/Blackstone/Brookfield/Goldman/KKR）；财报后股价上涨。本次财报确认AI资本开支周期完好。下季关注'中国'/'新加坡'收入行。更新于 2026-09-20

chinaEnergyIntensity.note: No new NBS data at the Sep 13 check (quarterly, next ~Oct). 15th FYP targets a 17% carbon-intensity cut by 2030. Forward demand: Wood Mackenzie expects China's data-centre electricity consumption to quadruple to 774 TWh by 2030 (6% of national consumption; 17% by 2060), with a 'compute follows power' shift sending training to renewable-rich western hubs; Gartner puts global DC consumption at 565 TWh in 2026 (+26%). IEA: China data centre electricity +~175 TWh (+170%) by 2030 — AI demand plus wind/solar curtailment pushed CO2 up ~2% in early 2026 (Carbon Brief). Renewed Hormuz escalation pushed dated Brent above $100 from Sep 3 and Brent to $104.61 on Sep 11 (+9% w/w) — higher-for-longer oil supports China's renewable acceleration while raising import costs; DeepSeek's Ulanqab 1GW DC adds AI-driven demand. AI distillation/cost-efficiency trend could reduce energy intensity faster than expected. Value stands at -3.2% YoY (est.) pending the next NBS release. Updated 2026-09-20
chinaEnergyIntensity.note_zh: 9月13日核查无新统计局数据（季度数据，下次约10月）。十五五目标2030年碳强度降低17%。前瞻需求：伍德麦肯兹预计中国数据中心用电到2030年增至四倍达774TWh（占全国用电6%；2060年17%），'算力跟着电力走'使训练西移至可再生能源富集枢纽；Gartner估计2026年全球DC用电565TWh（+26%）。IEA：中国数据中心用电到2030年增加约175TWh（+170%）——AI需求叠加弃风弃光推动2026年初CO2上升约2%（Carbon Brief）。霍尔木兹再度升级使即期布伦特自9月3日起高于$100、9月11日报$104.61（周涨9%）——油价高位更久支持中国可再生能源加速，同时抬高进口成本；DeepSeek乌兰察布1GW数据中心增加AI驱动电力需求。AI蒸馏/性价比趋势可能使能源强度下降快于预期。数值维持-3.2%同比（估算），待统计局下次发布。更新于 2026-09-20
